release_notes: v0.4.6.1: Packaged worker startup hotfix. Fixes the Celery worker dying after auto-update when the inherited APP environment variable poisons Celery's CLI (batches stuck at Pending forever). Scrubs unsafe Celery CLI environment variables before worker startup, renames the updater BAT variable APP to CK_APPDIR, adds worker health diagnostics to /api/support/status, and shows a worker-not-running warning instead of a silently pending batch. Includes all v0.4.6 stability/security/50-call readiness improvements.
